definitions.short: Zocheleth , a boundary stone in. Palestine
definitions.full: H2120. zocheleth זֹחֶ֫לֶת noun feminine meaning dubious; perhaps crawling thing, serpent (We Skizzen iii. 171 cites Arabic Zu—al = Saturn , in connection with 1Kin 1:9 ; compare Lane & Wetzst in De Hiob 2, 428 on view that Zu—al = he who withdraws , because of planet Saturn's remoteness) — only with article, in designated location הַזֹּחֶלֶת אֶבֶן עִם 1:9 (compare אֶבֶן near the end)
definitions.rootNote: feminine active participle of 2119 ; crawling (i.e. serpent);
